text.p: Here are the leading stories reported by Lithuania's newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Vilnius is gearing up for the May 1 Gipsy Kings concert.
- The Bank of Lithuania has lifted the loan restrictions on the state-run Savings Bank.
- Lithuania's parliament issued an appeal on Thursday to NATO countries uring them not to exclude the Baltic countries from the first wave of the alliance's eastward expansion.
- MP Rimantas Smetona intends to launch an anti-EU political movement.
- Lithuania's foreign ministry said that the latest Council of Europe report about the country's human rights situation was favourable.
- Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said on Thursday that the stability of the Baltic region would be threatened if Lithuania was excluded from the first wave of NATO expansion.
- Assets in Lithuania's banking sector fell by 29 percent in the first quarter of 1997.
- Lithuania's government may decide net week on the price of the new share issue for state-run Lithuanian Gas.
- Kaunas wool producer Kaunas Brobe was named the best wool company in Eastern Europe by the International Wool Secretariate, whic awarded the company a Woolmark trade mark.
